subject: Serving Core consolidation and QBR readiness - proposal & asks
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Serving Core consolidation and QBR readiness - proposal & asks

Team —

I ran the consolidation proposal by a few folks this morning and wanted to push the first draft into your inbox ahead of the exec QBR next week. High level: we propose aligning the Platform Growth and Runtime Stability pillars under a single "Serving Core" leadership to reduce cross-pillar handoffs and centralize ownership for latency/cost OKRs. The attached org chart shows role moves and a short OKR impact matrix that highlights risks to current deliverables.

Key asks (deadline: EOD Thu):
- Jonas: validate throughput-related SLAs and call out any delivery gaps you see in the "Runtime" section of the matrix.
- Lauren: confirm which PMs will transition to the new pillar and who will stay with Feature Platform (I flagged two roles on the chart).
- Marissa: compile a one-slide summary on customer-facing risk mitigation (SLOs, fallbacks, communications) — this will be in the QBR appendix.

Context and reasoning in short bullets:
- Our telemetry shows recurring coordination latency between teams when we need fast kernel fixes; this is costing us Q2 latency OKR headroom.
- Consolidation should improve single-owner accountability for rollout, canary policies, and model routing rules.
- We are not cutting headcount; this is a re-alignment to reduce cross-team dependencies and speed decision loops.

I added two artifacts in the Drive link below: a proposed org chart (v1) and an OKR impact matrix that maps current quarterly commitments to risk buckets. Bring any strong objections or suggested edits by Thu close — I want to present a cleaned version in the leadership slot on Fri afternoon.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Platform Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_org_chart_v1.png (image), okr-impact-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Serving Core consolidation and QBR readiness - proposal & asks

Thanks for the early sight, Olga. Quick notes after a first pass of the matrix:

- Runtime throughput: the canary cadence you propose will need an extra 2 weeks of perf-testing if we keep the current GPU mix on Dedicated. I'll add specific benchmark windows to the Drive doc.
- KV cache ownership: the chart moves this to Serving Core which makes sense; we should explicitly call out migration runbooks and a rollback window (I can draft that).
- Risk to customer SLAs: not high if we schedule overlapping coverage during the transition. I agree with Marissa's one-slide ask.

I'll drop a short perf appendix in the Drive folder by EOD Wed. If we want to accelerate, I can reassign an SRE pair to prioritize kernel tests next week.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
